title: Removing a customer asks first and puts them back on Default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders and tier A for Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, on tier A for work orders and tier A for Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Click Manage Customers.
  5. Click the Remove Customers tab.
  6. Tick customer A.
  7. Click Remove 1 Customer.
  8. Click Remove in the question.
  9. Open customer A's page from Customers.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Customers tab lists customers A and B.

Step 4:

  • The dialog opens on Add Customers.

Step 5:

  • The Remove Customers tab lists customers A and B with the count 2.

Step 6:

  • The footer sums up the removal.
  • The button reads "Remove 1 Customer" in red.

Step 7:

  • A question titled "Remove 1 Customer?" opens before anything is removed.

Step 8:

  • Tier A's Customers tab lists customer B.
  • Customer A is no longer listed.

Step 9:

  • Customer A's card shows Work Order Tier 1 · Default and Part Sales Tier 1 · Default.
